neighbours.label: the word 'syndrome' in any form (' syndrome', synd|rom|es, Russian синдр|ом); other names for disorders stay low
fire: Doctors described several overlap syndromes in the new review.
Her son was diagnosed with Asperger syndrome at the age of six.
Irritable bowel syndrome affects many adults in the region.
Withdrawal syndromes can begin within hours of the last dose.
The clinic specialises in rare inherited syndromes of the skin.
Tourette syndrome often begins with simple motor tics.
В отличие от других синдромов, этот проходит быстро.
Many pain syndromes are poorly understood by patients.
